title: Eco-friendly bismuth halide chalcogenide perovskites for solar energy harvesting
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2197-2206
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01523A, Paper
Jayawardane Thambugalage Sanjeewani Thakshila Jayawardane, Udugama Koralalage Don Muditha Akmal, Dengwei Hu, Pradeep Kumara Wijesekara Abeygunawardhana, Galhenage Asha Sewvandi
CH3NH3BiI2Se has been identified as a promising bismuth mixed halide chalcogenide compound for the development of sustainable perovskite solar cells.
